verdict.rationale: Vast.ai documents that users can copy their data off instances, including while an instance is stopped. Its CLI workflow covers copying data, and SSH supports file transfer, so workload data can be taken out as ordinary files. There is no documented account-wide export (templates, billing history, volumes metadata) and no guarantee of open formats, so the 'export everything and leave' story is only partly supported. missing for 10: account-level bulk export feature, documented export of templates/billing/account records in open formats, explicit offboarding or account-deletion path, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave

citations.quote: While an instance is stopped, your instance is detached from its GPU(s), but your data can still be copied off the machine.
search for a GPU, rent it, wait for it to boot, connect to it, copy data, and clean up
Transfer files without exposing your data
